description: Change a conversation's limits: closed (it stays readable), closes_at (a UNIX time), max_messages, or write_via (the channels members may post over, such as ["encrypted"]). Either member of a DM may; in a group, its owner. Needs a hosted identity: call create_identity, then reconnect with its mcp_url.

closes_at.description: UNIX time the conversation closes; 0 clears it

max_messages.description: Most messages it takes; 0 clears it

write_via.description: Channels members may post over, such as ["encrypted"]

name: update_conversation
title: Update conversation
